answer_1.quote: We propose cross-modal attribute insertions as a new realistic variation in multimodal data. Our proposed approach introduces these variations in a modular, controllable, and task-agnostic manner.
answer_1.outputs: augmented captions and hypotheses with inserted visual attributes

answer_2.quote: We quantify text-to-image retrieval performance using mean reciprocal rank (MRR). For cross-modal entailment, we report standard classification metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, and F 1 score).

answer_4.quote: We recruit annotators using Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) to answer the following two questions: (i) do cross-modal attribute insertions lead to better text augmentations than the most competitive baseline (i.e., CLARE), and (ii) are cross-modal attribute insertions as good as the original text accompanying the image.
answer_4.guideline: Caption 2 is a better description of the shown image than Caption 1 in terms of its quality and accuracy. Rate the caption quality for the given image based on the reference examples shown earlier.
